scientific_review: A presentation packet of existing evidence, not a measurement-gap admission or new observation. Canonical inventory v38 is unchanged.

Quantity-role categories describe metric names, not observation quality, physical-depth readiness, or evidence confidence. Published extent references in the context category may contain useful depth information; inspect their source definitions.

Do not interpret 27 proxy-supported identities as 27 measured physical current bottoms. A core-relative decay threshold, directional component isotach, and observed zero crossing are distinct definitions.
No numerical values are averaged, converted, subtracted or merged into a current-wide range. All source quantities selected for presentation retain their original values and censor flags.
Reported ranges are neither automatically annual ranges nor uncertainty margins. Layers and transport limits are distinct from depth coordinates.
All identities retain direct-owner membership. Missing evidence is null, not zero, bed contact, or absent flow. No whole-current depth, physical annual range, or volume is inferred.
The packet provides reference IDs, original source citations/pointers and qualifications. It is an export; no website cards, runtime, default query, or UI integration was installed.
